system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: This small addition to the system prompt changed the shape of our trajectories.
system_prompt_style.note: Blog only; prompt mechanism not described; per-agent system prompts exist.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: It uses read-only tools like shell commands and Python scripts to probe the live environment.
env_context_strategy.note: Executor explores via GUI, code and browser tools.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: A smaller model, Claude Haiku 4.5, handles context compaction in the background. It summarizes older steps when a task runs long enough to strain the primary model’s context window.

observation_format.evidence_quote: tools that read a file and hand the contents straight back, with PDFs and images passed in natively as input the model can see.
observation_format.note: Screenshot observations inferred from computer-use setting; browser returns page state via CDP.

tool_call_format.note: Tool schema mentioned but call syntax not stated; no repo in bundle.

tool_count.note: Tool groups listed (GUI, code, browser, background) without a count.

edit_primitive.note: No edit tool described; file writes via Python/Bash.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Browser – direct access to Chrome through the DevTools Protocol for reading page state cleanly.
protocol_standardization.note: Chrome DevTools Protocol is a browser protocol, not an agent/tool protocol; closest value. MCP/A2A not mentioned; the blog is not a registry, so their absence is not coded.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: It treats the agents as method tool calls and runs them in a strict sequence:
loop_primitives.note: Feasibility gate -> planner -> executor inner loop.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: A planner turns a possible task into a short list of target milestones.
planning_granularity.note: Executor can create sub-milestones and revise plan mid-task.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: What remains is a lightweight task controller and three specialized agents, each with a single responsibility.
multi_agent_topology.note: Controller orchestrates in strict sequence; could be read as orchestrator_workers.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: the task controller acts as a central orchestrator. It treats the agents as method tool calls and runs them in a strict sequence
delegation_mechanism.note: Agents invoked as tool calls by controller; closest value uncertain (could be subagent_spawn).

short_term_state.evidence_quote: It can also create sub-milestones and revise the plan mid-task when it finds evidence the original approach won’t work.

self_verification.note: An internal verifier agent was built experimentally; unclear if shipped in harness.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Ours are single runs, and they are the two highest recorded to date.
retry_policy.note: Reported runs single-attempt; harness retry config not visible.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: burning through its step budget on a dead end.
termination_condition.note: Feasibility gate can decline task; completion signal inferred.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Each runs on the model best suited to its job:

timeouts.evidence_quote: the environment forcefully kills any command that exceeds 120 seconds.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Only the executor interacts directly with the virtual machine to change the state of the desktop.
execution_isolation.note: Agent runs outside the VM on AWS.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: installing packages, reading and writing files

network_policy.note: Blog says sandbox blocks downloads but also that agent installed Tor; harness policy undocumented.

target_domain.evidence_quote: OSWorld is the standard benchmark for computer use agents

open_source.evidence_quote: We’re releasing the full system as open source

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: The two scores come from the same system. We ran it twice and changed only the model doing the work.
model_agnostic.note: Only Claude models (Opus 4.7, Sonnet 4.6) shown; multi-vendor support not demonstrated. Treat as weak.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: A new state of the art for computer use
primary_artifact.note: Engineering blog; repo URL not provided.
